task_metadata.research_topic: normalization layer design for deep convolutional neural networks
task_metadata.research_question: Design a novel normalization layer for deep convolutional neural networks that improves training stability and final test accuracy across different architectures and datasets.
notes: Task-scoped baselines in config.json are GroupNorm, Batch-Instance Norm, and Switchable Norm.
The task evaluates a BatchNorm2d-compatible replacement across ResNet-56/CIFAR-100, ResNet-110/CIFAR-100, and MobileNetV2/Fashion-MNIST.
Additional normalization papers are included to cover nearby design space exposed by local edit stubs and the broader research context.

tests.label: resnet56-cifar100
tests.notes: CIFAR-style ResNet evaluation on CIFAR-100 with cosine annealing; SGDR is the closest concrete scheduler paper.

tests.label: resnet110-cifar100
tests.notes: Hidden final-evaluation variant of the same CIFAR-style ResNet family and training setup.

tests.label: mobilenetv2-fmnist
tests.notes: MobileNetV2 architecture evaluated on Fashion-MNIST with the same cosine-annealed SGD scaffold.

baselines.name: group_norm
baselines.notes: Matches the Wu and He GroupNorm method.

baselines.name: batch_instance_norm
baselines.notes: Matches the learnable BatchNorm/InstanceNorm interpolation introduced in Batch-Instance Normalization.

baselines.name: switchable_norm
baselines.notes: Matches Switchable Normalization with learned mixing weights over BN, IN, and LN statistics.

papers.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
papers.relevance: Foundational baseline that the task asks agents to replace with a better BatchNorm2d-compatible normalization layer.
